dialer.description: Target calls = available agents × dial ratio, capped by max concurrent calls. Five errors in a row pause a campaign for 30 seconds.

dialer.triggerDisabled: Start the campaign to dial it
dialer.failHint: Originates fail for 10 seconds. Five in a row start the 30 second backoff.

toast.nothingHint: The pacing target is already reached or no agent is free.
toast.failedHint: Calls fail for 10 seconds. Watch the error counter reach the backoff.
